mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address_snapshot, created_at, paid_at, completed_at FROM orders status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address_snapshot, created_at, paid_at, completed_at FROM orders WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address_snapshot, created_at, paid_at, completed_at FROM orders WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, paid_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PAID' THEN COALESCE(paid_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE paid_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'COMPLETED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_at END WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
